## Classes
XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_order=Order XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_order_hint=Order of this step in the task. XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_element=Element XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_element_hint=The CSS selector of the element to be highlighted for this step. If no element is selected, the step will be displayed centered on the screen. XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_content=Content XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_content_hint=The content to display for this step. XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_placement=Placement XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_placement_hint=The placement of the step tooltip. XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_backdrop=Backdrop XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_backdrop_hint=Marks if a backdrop should be shown for this step. XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_reflex=Reflex XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_reflex_hint=Marks if clicking the highlighted element allows proceeding to the next step. XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_targetPage=Target page XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_targetPage_hint=The page on which the step should be displayed. If left empty, the current page will be used. XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_targetAction=Target action XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_targetAction_hint=The action on the target page. If left empty, the current action will be used. XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_queryParameters=Query parameters XWiki.GuidedTour.StepClass_queryParameters_hint=Parameters to append to the URL when navigating to the target page. XWiki.GuidedTour.TourClass_title=Title XWiki.GuidedTour.TourClass_title_hint=The tour title that will be displayed in the widget. XWiki.GuidedTour.TourClass_description=Description XWiki.GuidedTour.TourClass_description_hint=Description of the tour. XWiki.GuidedTour.TourClass_isActive=Is active XWiki.GuidedTour.TourClass_isActive_hint=Select if the tour should be active or not. A disabled tour will not be displayed in the guided tours widget. XWiki.GuidedTour.TaskClass_title=Title XWiki.GuidedTour.TaskClass_title_hint=The title of the task. It will be displayed in the widget. XWiki.GuidedTour.TaskClass_order=Order XWiki.GuidedTour.TaskClass_order_hint=Order of this task in the tour. XWiki.GuidedTour.TaskClass_dependsOn=Depends on XWiki.GuidedTour.TaskClass_dependsOn_hint=The tasks that need to be finished before beginning this one. XWiki.GuidedTour.TaskClass_isActive=Is active XWiki.GuidedTour.TaskClass_isActive_hint=Marks the task as active or not.
